finalCanvases.explanation:
The central tree retains the seed's five conceptual groups while shrinking from 11,250 to 8,263 characters (26.6%) and from 153 to 98 lines (35.9%). Six peripherals expand codec mechanics, retry behavior, validation, publication, read dependencies and storage ownership. [M] denotes modular structure, [C] call flow, [O] ownership and [D] data dependency; dependency chains overlay the organizational views. Edges attach to specific concept lines. Positions use measured text bounds, with at least 18 columns between diagram columns and 7 rows between vertically adjacent peripherals.

Only context.json's point and pinned sources, plus seed.json, support the content. Source mapping: codec uses canvasCheckpointRecords.ts; retry uses recordStorage.ts and workspaceRecordStore.ts; validate uses workspaceRecords.ts; publish uses canvasCatalogStore.ts and workspaceRecordStore.ts; reads uses diagramPersistence.ts and the two stores; blobs uses workspaceRecordStore.ts, diagramRevisionStore.ts and immutableRecords.ts. The central browser bridge also uses workspacePersistence.ts.

Corrections and qualifications: CanvasValueEncoder is exported, although its caches and splitting machinery are private. The bridge method is setPaused, not pause. capture hydrates the selected head and bound revisions but pins all document checkpoint/revision/item references. loadDiagramSourceBindings passes every stored catalog revision, not only current published heads. A supplied head map bypasses replay only in loadCanvasCheckpoint; restoreCanvasCheckpoints derives maps and compares the supplied head. UI installation after acknowledgement is a documented contract, not a verified caller behavior. Catalog serialization covers wrapped operations; saveRepresentationCatalog is public and does not itself enter that queue.

Additional source details include reverse diff application, placeholder validation, interrupted-view normalization, record namespace checks, first background retry at 1000 ms, the explicit commit loop's continued retry of conflicts, acceptance receipt comparison fields and source-binding cache invalidation. Durability claims are scoped: workspace publication explicitly syncs files and directories; DiagramRevisionStore has no explicit fsync. Catalog comments describe atomic replacement, but the imported writeJsonAtomic implementation is absent, so its implementation and crash durability cannot be verified. Imported validators and catalog rules are shown only at their supplied call boundaries. No cross-process locking, blob garbage collection or unprovided UI behavior is inferred.
